reviews.comment: She definitely is someone who knows a lot about dinosaurs and geology in general. The labs themselves really depend on the TA that you get as the TA that I got were both absolutely awesome. No exams for this class as its graded primarily on labs which can be time consuming but they can be fun if you are in a good group. Nice professor as well!
Super fun and easy science classes!
reviews.ratingTags: Participation matters--Group projects--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: I loved dinosaur world. You're only graded on your labs and a paper/ oral project but it was all super easy. I got almost always 100% on all my assignments and I barely tried. No tests or exams which was amazing. She has random in class assessments to see if you're going but I never did, got 0% on all of them, and I still ended the class with a A.
reviews.ratingTags: Group projects--Clear grading criteria--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: Good professor who cares about what they're teaching, even if the lectures may feel a bit like she's just reading off of the slides. Caan get a bit monotonous at times and the labs were much more work than I felt justified, but other than that. It's an easy A.

She's so sweet and you can tell she really cares about her class.  The class is not hard at all but it is based on labs that you have to do with a group, so make sure you get a good one.  Overall not a hard class at all, there are a few lecture papers though.

Dinosaur World is ok. I got an A but the labs were boring in my opinion and I didn't love my group. That is kinda my fault tho. My biggest pet peeve about this class was that she never put grades in and never replied to any of my emails. My TA was mid, and I just had a very mid experience in this class overall. Not hard tho.

She's amazing and there are ZERO tests throughout the semester. She kind of feels like a mix between a sweet grandmother figure and a mad scientist whose very passionate about her work. The TAs are the toss up in this course, as some grade very strictly and others with basically participation points. Luck of the draw, but an easy A nonetheless.

Honestly,if you don't have to, do not take this class. The professor is nice and clearly passionate but you're more so dealing w the TAs. Labs are hard and if your group isnt helpful it SUCKS. Passable if you really attend class and pay attention but otherwise, its kinda hard. No tests but labs are v boring and hard. they also never put in grades.

If you need science credit and are bad at science and math (like me) TAKE THIS CLASS FOR SOME CREDIT. Dr. Raymond is super chill, knowledgeable, and interesting. I barely went to class (sorry) at no fault to her, I was just a slacker lmao and still I feel like I learned and scoring an A was easy. Labs were pretty fun too. Def would take again!

She's very passionate about her lectures, and she posts her slides on Canvas before class. Beware of pop quizzes, however! The labs were very easy, and my TA was very nice. The content itself is dense, but we're able to use our notes for most of the assignments, which makes this class easy. She's very understanding and grades stuff easily.
reviews.ratingTags: Amazing lectures --Beware of pop quizzes--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: If you grew up a dinosaur kid like I did, you will fall in love with this class. She discusses all the important aspects of dinosaurs and goes super in-depth, so it's really interesting. The lab is fun, but be prepared to take most of the time allotted for lab.  Even if you're not one who is extremely passionate about dinosaurs, you soon will be.

Anne Raymond is the Dinosaur Queen. Her lectures are always fun and engaging and full of fun dinosaur facts. I initially took this class for an easy A, but I enjoy it a lot and have learned so much. The main issue people have with the class is the labs, which are not hard at all but they do take all 2 hours usually. Outstanding professor and person

As a student who never really goes to their "blow off" classes, Dr. Raymond's passion in her lectures motivates me to go regardless. She loves what she does and it is evident in her class. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a fun and simple class.
Nice prof! Always give you multiple attempts on HW. Recommend her! But the exams are challenging, but a good score is achievable as long as you study for the exams.

She is VERY passionate about her lectures which is always a good thing. She may be a little scattered brained, but she means well and wants you to succeed. The class does not require a lot of work except for the labs. Although the labs are super fun and definitely the best part of the course. Overall great class for a GPA booster.

Professor Raymond is a quirky lady who makes lectures fun. Her class was pretty manageable with online quizzes and homework weekly. If you go to lecture, take notes, and do the online MyLab assignments, the tests will be easy. Professor Raymond seems to really care about the topic that she teaches so it is fun to see here in her element lol.

Possibly the easiest class here at A&M, went to 3 lectures, just did the online assignments, 1 easy and fun group project, and literally everything is open note including the exams. Currently have a 97 before the open note final, which if it's anything like the other exams is nothing to stress about.

Professor Raymond is extremely caring. She is very accommodating, at least from my experience. She is passionate about what she teaches and she wants you to learn the information, and enjoy the class. Test were pretty difficult because of all the various terms, but they were open note so just make sure to take good notes.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Skip class? You won't pass.--Caring

reviews.comment: If "explain this to me like I'm five" was flipped upside down. She is a very passionate professor who cares for her work and what she does, but her wording and material is so far above this intro-level class. Exams are difficult and reviews are little help and she, unfortunately, doesn't answer emails. You will pass, but don't expect an A.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Professor Raymond is so sweet, and the class is really easy if you turn in everything on time! Basically don't get behind with the lab and you will be fine. Her reviews for the exams are very helpful.
Always ready to help how she can, despite COVID making all classes online, she has managed to stay available and update her teaching methods to fit the times.
reviews.ratingTags: Gives good feedback--Accessible outside class--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: I love this prof so much, she is so cute! Lectures aren't mandatory and she uploads slides towards the end of the chapter. Lab attendance is mandatory but it's honestly fun when you go to lab! At first it may seem tough and overwhelming, but trust me and stick with it. Don't need the book

Dr. Raymond is a fantastic professor and is one of the most enthusiastic people about their work that I know! There's lots of specific information that you're going to have to memorize in this course but the fact that it's about dinosaurs combined with Dr. Raymond's teaching style makes it fairly easy to remember and do well.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Amazing lectures

reviews.comment: Midterm and Final are the only grades in this class, with lab grades being around the other 40%. She posts slides online after her lectures, attendance isn't required by any means. However, tests are all short answers and are a big portion of your grade.
reviews.ratingTags: Graded by few things--Test heavy--Lecture heavy
